home.title: dafalabs — Software Studio
home.description: dafalabs is a software studio that designs, builds and maintains mobile and web applications.

hero.lede: We design, build and keep running mobile and web applications — long after they ship.

cta.label: Get started
cta.title: Have a project in mind?
cta.body: An idea is enough to start. Tell us what you want to build and we will work out together whether it is feasible and what it would take.

services.title: Services — dafalabs
services.description: Mobile apps, web development, UI/UX design and technical consulting.
services.label: Services
services.heading: We take a project from start to finish.
services.lede: The four areas below can be bought separately, but they work best together.

mobile.name: Mobile Apps
mobile.short: iOS and Android from a single codebase, delivered all the way to the store listing.
mobile.long: iOS and Android from a single Flutter codebase. Store account setup, release management and submission are part of the job.

web.name: Web
web.short: Company sites and web applications. Fast to load, visible to search engines, easy to maintain.
web.long: Company sites, web applications and the services behind them. Fast to load, visible to search engines, and maintainable a year later.

design.name: UI/UX
design.long: We map the flow before drawing a screen. Designing an interface before knowing what job the user is trying to finish gets expensive later.

consulting.name: Consulting
consulting.short: A second opinion on architecture and technology choices for a project already under way.
consulting.long: For a project already running: architecture review, a second opinion on technology choices, code quality and technical guidance for your team.

cta.title: Not sure which service you need?
cta.body: That is how most projects start. Tell us what you want to build and we will work out together which parts apply.

talk.name: Conversation
talk.body: We listen to what you want to build. Free, and it commits you to nothing.

scope.name: Scope and quote
scope.body: We break the work into items and put timing and budget in writing. No line items appear later.

build.name: Development
build.body: We ship a working build at regular intervals. You watch progress on a screen, not in a deck.

ship.name: Launch and after
ship.body: We handle the store and the servers. Support continues after release.

work.title: Work — dafalabs
work.description: Mobile and web projects built by dafalabs.
work.label: Work
work.heading: What we are building.
work.lede: The work we have taken on so far. Each card takes you straight to the project itself.

cta.title: The next project on this page could be yours.
cta.body: Everything on this page started the same way: with a conversation. Tell us what you want to build and we will map out the scope and timing together.
